privileged_info_for_vlm: The experiment must be at /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/nback_task.psyexp. The conditions file must be at /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/conditions/nback_conditions.csv. The conditions file must have >= 60 trials. Valid letters are uppercase consonants only (BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXZ). Target rate must be 20-40% (12-24 targets for 60 trials). The first two trials must be non-targets. In the Trial routine, the text component must use '$letter' and the keyboard component must accept 'space'.
